tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the primes less than or equal to the number, ascending (an empty Vector when there are none).
tasks.reference: 'N' BIND 2 N 2 MAX RANGE [ N GT NOT ] FILTER [ 'P' BIND 2 P RANGE -1 DROP [ 'D' BIND P D DIV FLOOR D MUL P EQ ] FILTER LENGTH 0 EQ ] FILTER

tasks.prompt: Leave a Vector of the positive divisors of the number, ascending.
tasks.reference: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV FLOOR D MUL N EQ ] FILTER

tasks.prompt: Leave the number written in base 2 as a String of '0' and '1' characters, without leading zeros.
tasks.reference: 'N' BIND 9 0 RANGE 'K' BIND 2 K POW 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR N P 2 MUL DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB [ STR ] MAP JOIN 'S' BIND S '1' SEARCH 'I' BIND '0' S CHARS I DROP JOIN I NIL? SELECT

tasks.prompt: Leave how many steps the Collatz rule takes to bring the number down to 1: an even number is halved, an odd number other than 1 becomes three times itself plus one (1 takes 0 steps).
tasks.reference: 'N' BIND 1 120 RANGE N [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND 1 A 2 DIV A 3 MUL 1 ADD A 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL A EQ SELECT A 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'S' BIND N 1 COLLECT S CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH

tasks.prompt: Leave the digital root: add up the decimal digits of the number, and keep adding up the digits of the result until a single digit remains.
tasks.reference: 1 SUB 9 DIV 'Q' BIND Q Q FLOOR SUB 9 MUL 1 ADD

tasks.prompt: With the Fibonacci numbers F(1) = 1, F(2) = 1 and F(k) = F(k-1) + F(k-2), leave the smallest k for which F(k) is at least the number.
tasks.reference: 'N' BIND 1 14 RANGE [ 1 1 ] [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 GET A 0 GET A 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP 'F' BIND [ 1 ] F CONCAT 'G' BIND 0 G LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND G I GET N LT NOT ] FILTER 0 GET 1 ADD
